notes.title: Update 0.22.4 - More ammo, bugfixes and improve localization!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I looked at player feedback and fixed several bugs in Angry Universe VR!
Here is a short summary:

[list]
[*] First of all, I drastically increased the amount of ammo. I hope this makes it less frustrating and more fun :)!
[*] If you end a level with a score that is too low to reach 1 star, you fail. However, the game didn't give you any kind of hint of what happened. That's now fixed and you get a proper explanation.
[*] I fixed a bug where you would fail a level if you destroy the last target with your last bullet.
[*] Dealing damage with the asteroid was a bit inconsistent. This is now fixed - Damage is now only partially calculated based on the impact velocity and I also added a fixed amount of damage when the asteroid touches an object. This makes it much easier to deal proper damage.
[*] I fixed a bug where throwing the asteroid in slow motion results in a weird trajectory.
[*] I improved the English and German localization.
[*] Incorrect labels for buttons on the holographic arm menu are now fixed.
[/list]

Hints:

[list]
[*] The damage combo meter on your right hand (the number in a blue ring) is very important. Destroying several small things in quick succession gives you a way higher score compared to destroying them one by one. !
[/list]
